derivative_method: Compact editorial derivative of a completed source audit; no semantic evaluation was rerun. Complete authored rows remain inspectable at the immutable source references.
row_hash_algorithm: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys, compact separators, and non-ASCII characters preserved

synthetic_data.note: No synthetic test inputs or generated images are included. Authored visual specifications are source data, not observed image results.

verdict.reason: No new contradictory physical assertion, wrong source owner, or mistranscribed research-to-installed relation was established in the bounded review.

coverage.whole_meaning_fields: Labels and aliases, positive definition, component discovery terms, required component evidence and gates, contrast limits, relation endpoints, and declared property effects.

rows.reason: Rounded caps remain attached to the selected surface; intervening texture belongs to that same surface.
Hanging drop is joined to the selected solid edge and wet contact patch.
Inner wall and central level belong to the same vessel water. Concavity is explicit in alias/context, less specific in English component; no opposite curvature asserted.
Exterior cold-surface droplets are separated from vessel contents. This is a narrow container realization, not a definition of all condensation.
Droplet volume distorts the viewed background. One optional discovery phrase says detached drop, but attachment state is not a hard obligation.
Separate attached and fallen drops coexist; receiver is on the fall path. No assertion that one drop is simultaneously attached and detached.
Airborne spray belongs to a visible collision zone fed by the same wave/outlet; no underwater gas substitution.
Raised liquid sheet is at the impacting object-water contact; detached drops lie beyond that sheet.
Known corrected README excluded. Crown remains rising liquid rim, spikes and detached drops, not surface foam.
Gas pockets are inside water; not water drops suspended in air.
Packed bubble patch floats on water. Does not assert impact crown or pollution from foam alone.
Sun/moon glints belong to wave facets/surface, not a submerged receiver or self-emitting particles.
Visible source object, its surface image and common water-plane geometry are retained. Explicit surreal different-person reflection remains separate.
Same object continues across the waterline with apparent optical displacement. Deliberate author script replaces material with structure; no physical break or duplicated object.

documented_source_adaptation.before: the same object's material continuing on both sides
documented_source_adaptation.after: the same object's structure continuing on both sides
documented_source_adaptation.interpretation: The explicit material-to-structure substitution preserves continuity of the same water-crossing object; it is not a newly discovered mistranscription.

rows.reason: Rippled transmitting surface and submerged textured receiver are specified; relation and effects place concentrated light on receiver, not surface glitter.
Underwater upward viewpoint, transmitted above-water region and surrounding underwater reflection form the intended narrow Snell-window realization.
